panel.title: Event 517/1102/1103/1104/1105 - The audit log has been cleared or full/stopped

search.query: index=winevents EventCode=517 OR EventCode=1102 OR EventCode=1104 OR EventCode=1104 OR EventCode=1105 | eval Event=case(EventCode==1102, "Audit log was cleared", EventCode==1103, "Security log is 90% full", EventCode==1104, "Security log is full", EventCode==1105, "Event log automatically backed up") | stats count BY host Event
index=winevents (EventCode=4624 Security_ID="PROGRAM*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) OR EventCode=528 | stats count by user | sort - count

panel.title: Event 529/4625 - Logon failure: Unknown user name or bad password

search.query: index=winevents (EventCode=4625 Failure_Reason="Unknown user name or bad password." Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) OR EventCode=529 | stats count by user | sort - count
index=winevents (EventCode=4625 Failure_Reason="*disabled*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) OR EventCode=531 | stats count by user | sort - count
index=winevents (EventCode=4625 Failure_Reason="*Expired*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) OR EventCode=535 | stats count by user | sort - count

panel.title: Event 539/4625 - Logon failure: Account locked out

search.query: index=winevents (EventCode=4625 Failure_Reason="*locked*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10) OR EventCode=535 | stats count by user | sort - count
index=winevents EventCode=4616 | stats count by user

panel.title: Event 560/4656 - A handle to an object was requested

search.query: index=winevents EventCode=4656 Security_ID="PROGRAM*" Access_Reasons="*Granted by*" NOT Access_Reasons="SYNCHRONIZE*" Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\INF*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\Program Files*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\System32*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\Tasks*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\Temp*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SECURITY*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SAM*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SYSTEM*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\HARDWARE*" | stats count latest(_time) AS _time values(Access_Reasons) AS "Access Result" BY user Object_Name | table _time user "Access Result" Object_Name count | sort - count

panel.title: Event 560/4656 - A handle to an object was requested

search.query: index=winevents EventCode=4656 Security_ID="PROGRAM*" Access_Reasons="*Not granted*" NOT Access_Reasons="SYNCHRONIZE*" Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\INF*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\Program Files*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\System32*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\Tasks*" OR Object_Name="C:\\Windows\\Temp*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SECURITY*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SAM*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SYSTEM*" OR Object_Name="\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\HARDWARE*" | stats count latest(_time) AS _time values(Access_Reasons) AS "Access Result" BY user Object_Name | table _time user "Access Result" Object_Name count | sort - count

panel.title: Event 577/4673 - A user attempted to perform a privileged system action

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype="security" user!="*$" EventCode=4673 OR EventCode=577 | stats count by user status privilege | sort - count
index=winevents sourcetype="security" EventCode=4719 OR EventCode=612 | stats count by host | sort - count
index=winevents sourcetype="security" EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4726 OR EventCode=624 OR EventCode=630 | rename src_user AS Admin | rename msad_action AS Action | table _time Admin Action user

panel.title: Event 632,636/4728,4732 - Security enabled group member added

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype="security" EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732 OR EventCode=632 OR EventCode=636 | rename src_user AS Admin | table _time Admin user Group_Name

panel.title: Event 633,637/4729,4733 - Security enabled group member deleted

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype="security" EventCode=4729 OR EventCode=4733 OR EventCode=633 OR EventCode=637 | rename src_user AS Admin | table _time Admin user Group_Name
index=winevents sourcetype="security" EventCode=4739 OR EventCode=643 | stats count by user | sort - count

panel.title: Event 645-647/4725,4741,4742,4743 - Computer account modified or deleted

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype="security" src_nt_domain="PROGRAM" (EventCode=4725 OR EventCode=4741 OR EventCode=4742 OR EventCode=4743 OR EventCode=645 OR EventCode=646 OR EventCode=647) | rename src_user AS Admin | table _time Admin action user | sort - _time

table.title: Includes Saturday & Sunday and between the hours of 6PM and 6AM

search.query: index=winevents sourcetype="security" EventCode=4624 Security_ID="PROGRAM*" Logon_Type=2 OR Logon_Type=7 OR Logon_Type=10 | eval hour=strftime(_time, "%H"), day=strftime(_time, "%A") | search (day IN("Saturday", "Sunday")) OR (hour >= 18 OR hour < 6) | eval Logon_Type_Description=case(Logon_Type==2, "Interactive", Logon_Type==7, "Unlock", Logon_Type==10, "Remote Interactive") | table _time host user Logon_Type_Description | sort - _time

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_MGMT | stats count by acct
index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_CMD | join pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct ] | stats count by acct res | sort - count

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=EXECVE | join type=left msg [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL | table msg pid res ] | join type=left pid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table pid acct res ] | stats count BY acct res | sort - count

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=SYSCALL (comm="cp" OR comm="mv" OR comm="rm" OR comm="touch" OR comm="vi" OR comm="vim" OR comm="nano" OR comm="emacs" OR comm="rmdir" OR comm="chmod" OR comm="chown" OR comm="chgrp" OR comm="umask" OR comm="setfacl") | join type=left uid [ search index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=USER_ACCT | table uid acct ] | stats count by acct comm | sort - count

panel.title: General configuration changes/General changes to hosts

search.query: index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=CONFIG_CHANGE | stats count by key op | sort - count

index=nix sourcetype=audit_log type=EXECVE | eval arg0=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a0,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg0=if(isnull(arg0), a0, arg0) | eval arg1=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a1,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg1=if(isnull(arg1), a1, arg1) | eval arg2=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a2,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg2=if(isnull(arg2), a2, arg2) | eval arg3=urldecode(ltrim(replace(a3,"([a-fA-F0-9]{2})","%\1"),"0x")) | eval arg3=if(isnull(arg3), a3, arg3) | eval cmdline=coalesce(arg0, "") + " " + coalesce(arg1, "") + " " + coalesce(arg2, "") + " " + coalesce(arg3, "") | eval cmdline=trim(replace(cmdline, "\s+", " ")) | search "/var/log/*" OR "/etc/audit/*" | stats count by cmdline | sort - count
